svg.title: Guardrails. Two modes: discovery, the default, searches, validates, scores and ranks and never submits anything; application mode (set mode: application in the config) prepares applications and fills non sensitive fields, then stops. It always stops and hands back to you for legal declarations, compensation expectations, EEO and demographic questions, work authorization, relocation commitments, anything binding, and anything involving payment or financial details. It will not invent a recruiter, email, job ID, URL or company; fabricate experience, metrics or certifications; claim an application was submitted unless submission was confirmed; submit a duplicate application; or bypass CAPTCHA, MFA or bot protection. If a site cannot be reached it is marked unavailable rather than reported as processed.
